extracted.intended_audience: attorneys and filers before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit (including patent practitioners), court clerks, and appellate counsel
extracted.subtask_description: Summary of adopted February 2023 amendments to the Federal Circuit Rules of Practice, highlighting changes to filing, brief, appendix, scheduling, and related procedural requirements relevant to appellate practice (including patent-related specifics).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fed. Cir. R. 15: Updating jurisdictional statutes and USPTO address in Practice Notes
rubrics_metrics.description: Updating jurisdictional statutes and USPTO address in Practice Notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fed. Cir. R. 25: Decreasing required number of paper copies on rehearing or hearing en banc
rubrics_metrics.description: Decreasing the required number of paper copies on rehearing or hearing en banc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fed. Cir. R. 26: Codifying day after Thanksgiving as official court holiday
rubrics_metrics.description: Codifying the day after Thanksgiving as an official court holiday.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fed. Cir. R. 27: Reconsideration requests must be rehearing petitions with limited exceptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarifying that requests for reconsideration of dispositive orders must be filed as rehearing petitions with limited exceptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fed. Cir. R. 28: Addendum organization, standard of review heading, patent claim language, and informal brief form clarifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Moving the principal brief addendum requirements to their own subsection and addressing multi-volume addenda; requiring a separate heading for the standard of review and clarifying location expectations; clarifying patent claim language on inside front cover of principal briefs and relocating requirement to FCR 32; clarifying informal brief form requirement; requiring separate heading for the jurisdictional statement in informal response briefs; adding Practice Note to address inclusion of patents in the addendum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fed. Cir. R. 28.1: Adjust citation to FCR 28 per new addendum subsection
rubrics_metrics.description: Adjusting citation to FCR 28 to correspond with new addendum subsection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fed. Cir. R. 30: Appendix expectations, brief titles identifying appendices, unrepresented parties, and service of paper copies
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarifying expectation for inclusion of patent and rehearing orders in the appendix; requiring brief title to identify when it contains an appendix; permitting unrepresented parties to file additional record material attached to a reply brief when the appellee files a separate appendix; adding Practice Note to address inclusion of patents in the appendix; requiring service of a paper copy of the appendix on opposing principal counsel unless counsel deems it unnecessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fed. Cir. R. 31: Eliminating separate briefing schedule for informal briefing and appendix service
rubrics_metrics.description: Eliminating separate briefing schedule for informal briefing; requiring service of a paper of the appendix on opposing principal counsel unless counsel deems it unnecessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fed. Cir. R. 32: Relocate patent claim language, spacing, and word-count exclusions
rubrics_metrics.description: Relocating patent claim language on inside front brief cover requirement to this rule from FCR 28 and permitting single-spacing of this language; excluding inside front cover contents and contents required on the first page of a filing in lieu of a cover from word counts; clarifying informal brief form and type-volume requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fed. Cir. R. 33: Eliminate settlement negotiation certification; encourage mediation and merge FCR 33.1
rubrics_metrics.description: Eliminating settlement negotiation certification requirement; adding language encouraging use of the mediation program and apprising court of ongoing settlement discussions; merging mediation provision of FCR 33.1 into 33.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fed. Cir. R. 33.1: Delete rule and merge mediation and docketing language elsewhere
rubrics_metrics.description: Deleting the rule and merging mediation language into FCR 33 and docketing statement language into FCR 47.6.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fed. Cir. R. 34: Argument scheduling conflict notice, clerk authority, response responsibility, and oral-argument materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Requiring parties to file argument scheduling conflict notice, even if no conflicts exist; delegating authority to the clerk of court to set scheduling conflict limitations and accept or reject individual conflict dates; clarifying who must file a response to notice of oral argument; clarifying that parties represented by the same counsel can only have one counsel argue; requiring arguing counsel to have copies of each brief and appendix close at hand at oral argument; adding Practice Note encouraging parties to have paper copies at oral argument.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fed. Cir. R. 35: Align with FCR 25 decrease in paper-copy requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Aligning with change to FCR 25 to decrease required number of paper copies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fed. Cir. R. 38: Practice Note directing filers to follow Rule 27 for sanctions motions
rubrics_metrics.description: Adding Practice Note to direct filers to follow Rule 27 when filing motions for sanctions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fed. Cir. R. 39: Adjust citations for copies taxable in bill of costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Adjusting citations to rules for copies taxable in the bill costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fed. Cir. R. 40: Align with FCR 25 decrease in paper-copy requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Aligning with change to FCR 25 to decrease required number of paper copies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fed. Cir. R. 41: Adjust types of orders constituting the mandate
rubrics_metrics.description: Adjusting the types of orders that will constitute the mandate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fed. Cir. R. 42: Practice Note regarding new court form to satisfy FRAP 42(b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Adding Practice Note regarding use of new court form to satisfy requirements for FRAP 42(b).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fed. Cir. R. 47.4: Cite to FCR 47.5 for related case requirement in certificate of interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Citing to FCR 47.5 for related case requirement in certificate of interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fed. Cir. R. 47.5: Expanded related-case notice to include other tribunals and new form Practice Note
rubrics_metrics.description: Creating expanded notice requirement when there are related cases in other tribunals in order to provide the court with more information on participating parties, firms, and attorneys; adding Practice Note regarding use of new court form to satisfy requirement for notice of related case information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fed. Cir. R. 47.6: New rule requiring filing of the docketing statement and Practice Note on form use
rubrics_metrics.description: Creating new rule requiring filing of the docketing statement; adding Practice Note regarding use of the court’s docketing statement form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fed. Cir. R. 47.7: Practice Note to follow Rule 27 for sanctions in the form of attorney fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Adding Practice Note to direct filers to follow Rule 27 when filing motions for sanctions in the form of attorney fees.
